title: Microsoft’s Project Zenith is a ‘distraction-free Windows experience’ for developers
summary: Microsoft launched Project Zenith, a Windows experience tailored for developers on high-end devices with 64GB+ unified memory. The preconfigured setup includes developer tools and enables running large local AI models (30B+ parameters) without metering, targeting developers seeking distraction-free AI experimentation environments.
content:
Microsoft is giving its developer-optimized Windows experience a name: Project Zenith. While the software maker originally announced a similar developer-optimized Windows effort at Build earlier this year, Project Zenith is designed for new developer-focused devices with 64GB or more of unified memory.
"Project Zenith devices come with a preconfigured Windows setup for development and a set of tools curated for what developers reach for first," explains Logan Iyer, CVP of Windows platform and developer at Microsoft. "On these devices, developers can run 30B+ parameter models locally and unmetered - accelerating experimentation while helping …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: 微软推出了Project Zenith，这是一款面向高端设备开发者（配备64GB+统一内存）的Windows体验。该预配置设置包括开发者工具，支持运行大型本地AI模型（30B+参数）而无需计量，目标是满足寻求无干扰AI实验环境的开发者。

title: Sam Altman apologizes for ‘messy’ GPT-6 Astra rollout that’s locked out paying users
summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, marketed as a "generational leap" toward AGI, but the rollout was chaotic and locked out paying users from expected immediate access. CEO Sam Altman apologized for the "messy" launch, with the model rolling out to enterprise customers first and broader access coming later.
content:
Just hours after OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, CEO Sam Altman was already apologizing for what he describes as a "messy rollout" after paying users expecting access to the new frontier model were left waiting.  
The company hailed the model as a "generational leap in capability" on Thursday and described it as the start of "the AGI era," a fuzzy and poorly-defined term tech executives nevertheless insist on using to promote their products. It said Astra would roll out to some enterprise customers - specifically those with access to its Daybreak cybersecurity platform - that day. This would expand to include all Plus, Pro, Business, and Enter …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Sam Altman为"混乱的"GPT-6 Astra发布导致付费用户被锁定而道歉
zh.summary: OpenAI发布了GPT-6 Astra，将其营销为"向AGI的代际飞跃"，但发布过程混乱，导致付费用户无法立即访问。CEO Sam Altman为"混乱的"发布道歉，该模型首先推出给企业客户，更广泛的访问权限随后推出。

title: This NAS company wants to run your local smart home
summary: Ugreen introduced the HomeAgent platform at IFA, combining local storage, on-device AI, and smart home control managed by voice assistant Uliya. The system processes everything locally rather than relying on cloud services, with multiple hub configurations available for different smart home needs.
content:
Ugreen’s HomeAgent H100 Pro hub combines local storage, on-device AI, and a new voice assistant, Uliya, to run your smart home. | Photo by Jennifer Pattison Tuohy / The Verge	

Ugreen, known for its phone power banks, chargers, and NAS storage solutions, is moving into the smart home - in a big way. This week at the IFA tech show, the company launched its HomeAgent smart home platform that combines security camera storage, on-device AI, and smart home control in one system, managed by a voice assistant called Uliya, with the promise that everything runs locally.  
At the core of Ugreen's HomeAgent system is a hub that acts as the brain of your smart home, running a local-first AI (with some caveats) that you can interact with using natural language via Uliya. There are three hub configurations to choose from, each …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 这家NAS公司想要运营你的本地智能家居
zh.summary: Ugreen在IFA上推出了HomeAgent平台，结合了本地存储、设备端AI和由语音助手Uliya管理的智能家居控制。该系统在本地处理所有内容，而不是依赖云服务，为不同的智能家居需求提供多种集线器配置。

title: Lexar’s Muse is an ultra-slim portable SSD that’s less than 4mm thick
summary: Lexar unveiled the Muse Ultra-Slim Portable SSD, measuring just 3.8mm thick through high-density NAND and custom PCB design. The drive offers up to 1,050MB/s read speeds, making it suitable for 4K ProRes video recording at 120fps, shipping later this year in 512GB and 1TB capacities.
content:
Following the lead of companies like Xteink, Lexar is the latest to sacrifice a USB-C port in the pursuit of slimming down its hardware.
When the Lexar Muse Ultra-Slim Portable SSD launches later this year in 512GB and 1TB capacities it will be one of the slimmest you can buy. At its thickest point in the middle it measures just 3.8mm, but that tapers to only 1mm at the edges thanks to high-density NAND stacking and a "custom ultra-thin PCB architecture" inside. But performance remains solid with read speeds up to 1,050MB/s and write speeds maxing out at 1,000MB/s. That's fast enough to record 4K Apple ProRes video at up to 120fps when conn …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: Lexar推出Muse Ultra-Slim便携式SSD，厚度仅为3.8mm，采用高密度NAND和自定义PCB设计。该驱动器提供高达1,050MB/s的读取速度，适合4K ProRes视频以120fps录制，今年晚些时候以512GB和1TB容量出货。

title: Aqara goes all in on smart lighting
summary: Aqara unveiled a major smart lighting lineup at IFA compatible with Zigbee and Thread protocols, including the Floor Lamp T1 with RGBIC lighting and 18 individually addressable zones. The company is also expanding into outdoor smart lighting solutions.
content:
After showing off several smart home firsts at CES, Aqara has returned to IFA with a major lineup of smart lighting compatible with both Zigbee and Thread. One of these new devices is the Floor Lamp T1, which trades the look of a typical lamp for an LED-equipped pole attached to a base. 
The lamp stands 4.6 feet tall, offering RGBIC lighting and 18 individually addressable zones. Similar to the floor lamp from Govee, Aqara's new device emits light in the area surrounding it, creating a splash of color on your wall.
Aqara is getting into smart lighting for the outside of your home as well. In addition to new permanent outdoor smart lights w …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: Aqara在IFA上推出了主要的智能照明产品线，兼容Zigbee和Thread协议，包括具有RGBIC照明和18个独立可寻址区域的台灯T1。该公司还在扩展户外智能照明解决方案。

title: This rugged phone’s removable camera can survive and capture your extreme adventures
summary: RugOne's Xsnap 7 Pro rugged phone features a removable camera module that doubles as a standalone action camera, with IP68/IP69K ratings for extreme durability. The phone survives complete submersion up to 30 minutes, launching via Kickstarter September 7 at €799, with global availability in October for $999.
content:
RugOne's Xsnap 7 Pro comes with both an IP68 and IP69K rating, meaning the rugged phone can survive intense water blasts and complete submersion for up to 30 minutes. But what really sets the Xsnap 7 Pro apart from everything else on the market is that one of its three rear cameras can be removed and used as a standalone action cam. It made its debut at MWC 2026 earlier this year but is launching through Kickstarter on September 7th for €799 (around $930) in limited quantities, followed by a global release in October for $999.
The Xsnap 7 Pro's detachable camera module isn't quite as a capable as the DJI Osmo Nano or the Insta360 Go Ultra t …

title: The sameness problem behind those unappetizing AI-generated menus
summary: Restaurant owners using generative AI for menu design often produce visibly generic results that customers instinctively recognize as artificial. The sameness problem reflects how AI models generate similar outputs, limiting effectiveness for creative tasks requiring visual distinction.
content: While restaurant owners might look to generative AI as a shortcut to sprucing up their menu, customers can viscerally sense that something is wrong with the food.

zh.title: AI生成菜单背后的"千篇一律"问题
zh.summary: 使用生成式AI设计菜单的餐厅老板通常会产生明显通用的结果，客户凭直觉就能识别为人工生成。这个"千篇一律"问题反映了AI模型如何生成相似的输出，限制了需要视觉差异化的创意任务的有效性。

title: Nvidia will officially bring DLSS 5 to older GPUs — but won’t give gamers full control
summary: Nvidia is expanding DLSS 5 AI rendering support beyond exclusive RTX 50 GPUs to include older RTX 40-series cards, following pressure from leaked modded versions already in circulation. The decision broadens access to the technology despite ongoing developer concerns about creative control. The move reflects market demand for wider GPU compatibility.
content:
Officially, Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 AI rendering was supposed to launch this evening with only a single game, only on Nvidia's latest RTX 50 GPUs, and with developers in full control of their artistic vision.
But unofficially, modders have already ported a leaked version of DLSS 5 to run on just about anything while cranking sliders to the max. Now, Nvidia is changing its plans. DLSS 5 is still launching first on RTX 50 GPUs, but it's officially coming to older RTX 40-series GPUs as well, Nvidia spokesperson Rajal Maharaj confirms to The Verge.
"Our current focus is on optimizing performance for the GeForce RTX 50 Series with model u …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 英伟达将正式为旧版GPU提供DLSS 5支持——但不会给玩家完全控制权
zh.summary: 英伟达正在扩展DLSS 5人工智能渲染支持，从专属RTX 50 GPU扩展到包括旧版RTX 40系列显卡，这是在已经流传的泄露修改版本的压力下作出的决定。尽管开发者对创意控制仍有顾虑，该决定还是拓宽了该技术的使用范围。这一举措反映了市场对更广泛GPU兼容性的需求。

title: Crusoe reportedly raises $3B at a  $30B valuation
summary: Data center developer Crusoe Technologies has raised $3 billion at a $30 billion valuation, backed by a reported $13 billion contract with Jane Street. The massive funding round reflects investor confidence in specialized AI infrastructure for large-scale computing workloads.
content: The round came together after the data center developer reportedly secured a $13 billion contract with Jane Street.

title: The unusually muted Tesla Cybercab launch
summary: Tesla officially launched the Cybercab at a private, invitation-only event in Austin, marking a key milestone in Elon Musk's autonomous vehicle strategy. The unusually low-key announcement—without livestream or press—contrasted sharply with Tesla's typical high-profile launches. The muted event suggests Tesla may be adopting a different approach to introducing its flagship autonomous vehicle.
content:
At a private, closed-door event in Austin, Texas today, Tesla officially launched its gilded car of the future: the Cybercab. It's a huge milestone for Elon Musk, who has been hyping the imminent arrival of driverless cars for years and has bet the future of his company on AI, autonomous vehicles, and humanoid robots.
It was an unusually muted event, with no livestream, no journalists, and a very short invite list comprised mostly of pro-Tesla content creators. Tesla influencers planning live shows with the event stream were left streaming the webpage that tracks the number of Tesla robotaxis in Texas instead. 
But if the goal was to blunt …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 特斯拉Cybercab发布会出人意料地低调
zh.summary: 特斯拉在奥斯汀一场私人仅限邀请参加的活动中正式发布了Cybercab，这标志着埃隆·马斯克自动驾驶汽车战略中的关键里程碑。这场出人意料地低调的发布会——没有直播或新闻发布——与特斯拉通常高调的发布会形成了鲜明对比。这场低调的活动表明特斯拉可能在采取不同的方式来推介其旗舰自动驾驶汽车。
